purpose: Define deterministic machine-readable validation findings with explicit severity, rule identity, source location, semantic target and remediation context.

topics.name: Validation Finding and Severity
topics.purpose: Define deterministic machine-readable validation findings with explicit severity, rule identity, source location, semantic target and remediation context.

semantics.location_rule: Where a physical artifact is involved, finding may include source artifact/path and machine-readable field/ref location without making that path semantic identity.
semantics.fatal_rule: fatal prevents continued trustworthy validation of the affected scope.
semantics.error_rule: error prevents pass/lock eligibility unless an explicit permitted exception applies.
semantics.warning_rule: warning remains visible but does not fail by default unless an owning policy upgrades it.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Equivalent repeated findings may be deduplicated by explicit key while preserving occurrence provenance.

invariants.rule: Validation outcomes, findings, exceptions, evidence, baselines and release decisions are explicit machine-readable facts and never silently rewrite source semantics.

hard_gates.condition: finding lacks rule identity or semantic target
fatal/error finding silently omitted from result
severity inferred only from free-form prose
filesystem path treated as semantic finding identity

prose.summary: Define deterministic machine-readable validation findings with explicit severity, rule identity, source location, semantic target and remediation context.
